brief: A deep indigo background remains static while a continuous white EKG waveform traces across the canvas, pulsing with the color of its own trace. The pattern flows rhythmically without user interaction, creating a living medical visualization. No mouse input or audio is required; the animation proceeds entirely on its own loop until closed.
